title: Verify cancelling the invoice-gate core resolution leaves the WO completed, un-invoiced and cores-pending
custom_preconds:
1. Signed in as Admin.
  2. A completed work order has an unresolved special-order core and you are in the invoice-gate resolve module.
custom_steps:
1. Cancel the resolve module.
  2. Inspect the work order and invoice state.
custom_expected:
1. The work order remains Completed.
  2. It remains un-invoiced.
  3. Cores remain pending.
  4. Note: because the core cannot be skipped at completion, this cancel path applies after completion at the Create Invoice gate; the core stays pending and the work order stays un-invoiced until it is received and resolved.
